Alex R: Morning — quick async shift bulletin.
Alex R: What I did: triaged PD alerts overnight (us-east), muted a noisy rule for token-generation-error >200/min, correlated with the midnight deploy.
Alex R: Blockers: seeing tail latency spikes for seq len >2048 on a subset of dedicated nodes; suspect kernel mismatch on one node. Need a staging perf run to confirm.
Alex R: Today: plan to roll a short canary of runtime v1.8 with adjusted kernel selection + bump batching timeout.
Maria K: Thanks Alex — I'll try to reproduce the tail spikes on staging and capture traces. Ping me if you want me to run against a specific node.
Maria K: I'm also updating the runbook for the gen-token-errors alert to include mute/unmute steps and the temporary debounce guideline.
Junaid: @Maria K if you need infra, I can spin up a 2xA10 sandbox pool. Also, small ask: pls review/approve my CR #4827 (reduces sampling window for invocation-rate alerts).
Liz C: On it — reviewing CR now. Will leave one comment about documenting the 30s window choice.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty PD-8843 closed by Alex R — severity reduced to S1 (2124678100).
Sam M: FYI I temporarily set alert debounce to 10s for token errors while we validate the canary. Will revert after canary + verification.
Alex R: @Sam M please add a one-line note in the alert Jira (ALERT-332) about the temporary debounce and reason.
Sam M: done — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ALERT-332
oncall-scheduler: Next rotation start 2124700000 — oncall: Liz C
Liz C: Acknowledged. I'll watch the canary window and will escalate if p99/tail > 250ms.
Alex R: For the perf capture use: ```kubectl exec -n runtime pod/bench-1 -- ./run_bench --model=text-4b --len=2048 --profile```
Maria K: running that now, will paste numbers here when done.
Junaid: pinging infra: the problematic node id in staging was gpu-7 in pool-dedicated-2 — I'll cordon it and reprovision.
Sam M: created infra ticket INFRA-721 for reprovisioning and node diagnostics.
Maria K: Perf results: p95=132ms, p99=378ms, tail samples show one host spiking to ~900ms intermittently. Screenshot attached in thread.
Junaid: cordoned gpu-7, reprovision in progress. If reprovision fixes it we can proceed with canary; otherwise we open a kernel-debug story.
Liz C: Will post go/no-go by 2100 PT. If canary proceeds, I'll monitor and escalate as needed.
Alex R: Updated blockers: need CR approval + one staging perf pass. If both green, will kick canary tonight. If not, rollback plan ready.
Maria K: thanks all — will follow up with the trace link and tail logs in a minute.
